verified: The poster, /u/trungh98, discloses that he is one of the study's authors and links a paper (alphaxiv 2611.17334), a project blog/FAQ and author X threads; an arXiv cs.CV recent-submissions listing independently shows a paper titled "Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding" (tool-2-1). The post itself states the experimental design: 200+ MLLMs trained from scratch on identical data with encoder pretraining charged to the same compute budget, main comparisons at Qwen3-1.7B/4B with 0.4B vision parameters, a 0.6B–6.4B scaling ladder, and evaluation on 16 Cambrian VQA benchmarks at 448 px plus 12 language benchmarks.
unconfirmed: Every quantitative result — pretrained encoders only tying from-scratch ones, encoder-free models needing ~3x compute, 45.0 vs 44.4 VQA for in-fusion vs encoder at 1.7B, ~13% lower time to first token, and the 80.4%→84.4% ImageNet gain from 6.5x longer MetaCLIP pretraining — rests solely on the authors' own summary, with no independent replication or peer-review outcome given; the Reddit post is also truncated, so per-benchmark breakdowns and the claimed gaps between Gemma 4 12B, Kimi K3 and Inkling 2 Small cannot be checked from the supplied material.

verified: 预印本《Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding》确实已公开（arXiv 编号 2611.17334，标题亦出现在 arXiv cs.CV 最新列表中）；作者之一 /u/trungh98 在 r/MachineLearning 发帖说明，实验用同一份数据从零训练 200 多个多模态大模型，主对比基于 Qwen3-1.7B 与 4B 骨干加 0.4B 视觉参数，评测集为 Cambrian 的 16 个 448px VQA 基准和 12 个语言基准。
unconfirmed: 全部结论数字——视觉编码器预训练“最多打平”、无编码器模型需约 3 倍算力追平、in-fusion 降低约 13% 首 token 延迟、1.7B 下 45.0 对 44.4 的 VQA 分数——目前仅出自作者自述的预印本，未经同行评审或第三方复现；帖子本身是摘要，未列出完整基准表，也未交代“免费预训练”对照的具体设置。
